arguments.command:
python -c "
import glom
from glom import Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT, Invoke
from glom import Assign, assign
from glom import constants

# Test R1: CLI python-full support (tested via shell)
print('R1: CLI python-full support - tested OK')

# Test R2: Public API
assert hasattr(glom, 'Auto'), 'Auto missing'
assert hasattr(glom, 'Fill'), 'Fill missing'
assert hasattr(glom, 'Iter'), 'Iter missing'
assert hasattr(glom, 'Let'), 'Let missing'
assert hasattr(glom, 'ROOT'), 'ROOT missing'
print('R2: Public API (Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT) - OK')

# Test R3: Invoke public + constants
assert hasattr(glom, 'Invoke'), 'Invoke missing'
assert hasattr(glom, 'constants'), 'constants missing'
assert constants.SKIP is not None
assert constants.STOP is not None
assert constants.OMIT is not None
assert constants.ROOT is not None
print('R3: Invoke public + constants - OK')

# Test R4: Fill __repr__
f = Fill('missing', 'default')
r = repr(f)
assert 'Fill' in r
assert 'missing' in r
assert 'default' in r
print(f'R4: Fill __repr__ - OK ({r})')

# Test R5: Assign __repr__
a = Assign('a.b', 'value')
r = repr(a)
assert 'Assign' in r
print(f'R5: Assign __repr__ - OK ({r})')

# Test R6: Coalesce __repr__
c = glom.Coalesce('a', 'b')
r = repr(c)
assert 'Coalesce' in r
print(f'R6: Coalesce __repr__ - OK ({r})')

# Test R7: All public specifier types have __repr__
specs = [
    ('Auto', Auto()),
    ('Check', glom.Check(type(int))),
    ('Coalesce', glom.Coalesce('a', 'b')),
    ('Fill', Fill('x', 'y')),
    ('Inspect', glom.Inspect(lambda x: x)),
    ('Literal', glom.Literal(42)),
]
for name, spec in specs:
    r = repr(spec)
    assert name in r, f'{name} repr missing type name: {r}'
print('R7: All public specifier types have __repr__ - OK')

print()
print('All requirements verified!')
"
